text: Sea's Digital Entertainment (Garena) revenue rose 26.1%, from US$1.9 billion in 2024 to US$2.4 billion (US$2,408.8 million) in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.100, F-3]. Per the filing, the increase was primarily driven by growth in the active user base combined with deepened paying-user penetration: average Game Quarterly Active Users (QAUs) rose 5.7% from 622.3 million to 657.7 million, while average Game Quarterly Paying Users (QPUs) rose more sharply, 23.9%, from 50.5 million to 62.6 million [Sea, FY2025, p.100]. This also fed through to stronger bookings (GAAP revenue plus change in deferred revenue, used as a proxy for cash spent by users), which contributed to an increase in deferred revenue and higher digital entertainment gross profit in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.107].
